dialogues.speaker: Viljami
dialogues.text: There are cathedrals everywhere for those with eyes to see. If you seek value in the eyes of the world, then you should be able to find some buried Rainbowdrop Crystals nearby.

dialogues.speaker: Viljami
dialogues.text: Once, such a discovery would've thrilled me... but now? Rainbowdrop Crystals or a mere pebble at my feet... Kick a stone by any other name, and it would hurt just as much.

dialogues.speaker: Viljami
dialogues.text: But no doubt, you have your own path to walk. Let me mark the location of the crystals for you. However, what you do next is your choice to make, friend.
